metadata.name: [REP+] reHUD [Forked]
metadata.description:
Requires Repentance+. A Repentance+ port of [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1906405707]reHUD[/url] by wofsauge. Adds a more customizable smaller version of the "Extra HUD", which displays the gametime and a list of collected items on the screen.
[h1][b]Disable or unsubscribe the original reHUD when using this fork![/b][/h1] Only one of the two runs when both are enabled.
[h1]What this fork changes[/h1] - [b]Runs on Repentance+[/b]. The original targets Afterbirth+. - [b]Settings through [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]Mod Config Menu Impure[/url][/b] (Pure works too; do not enable both), saved in reHUD's own save. - [b]Follows the HUD Offset option.[/b] - [b]Shows as many items as fit on screen[/b], newest first, grouped by floor. - [b]Repentance floor names, in every game language[/b]: Russian, Japanese, Korean and Chinese floor names no longer show up blank. - [b]New filters[/b]: active items, and temporary items (Lemegeton wisps, Zodiac, 3 Dollar Bill), which are marked with a small clock. - [b]Timer[/b] shows hundredths of a second.
[h1][b]Disable "Extra HUD" in the Options menu when using this mod [/b][/h1]
[h1]You need [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951]"Mod Config Menu Impure"[/url] to customize this mod![/h1]
[b]This mod does [u]not[/u] disable achievements![/b]
[h1]Support[/h1] Bugs, questions, ideas: [url=https://discord.gg/5KvKaUpsvR]Discord[/url]
[h1]Special Thanks[/h1] to wofsauge for the original reHUD! to Piber for the Mod config menu! to Skojanza for helping bugfix the original mod to _Kilburn for the screen-size helper in the original mod
[h1]Original description (Afterbirth+)[/h1] [spoiler]Adds a more customizable smaller version of the "Extra Hud", which displays the gametime and a list of collected items on the screen.
[h1]Features[/h1] - [b]Display your last collected items on the screen[/b]. over 100 of them instead of the last 10 in the normal game - [b]Customize the display[/b]: Position (Right, Bottom), Amount of Coloumns, Size, Transparency,... (Requires [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1603631350]Mod Config Menu[/url]!) - [b]Display a more accurate ingame Timer![/b] Precise up to milliseconds ;) - [b]Filter your items[/b]. Display Passives or only Familiars. - [b]Sort your items[/b]. Order them by the floor they are collected on.
[h1][b]Disable "Extra HUD" in the Options menu when using this mod [/b][/h1]
[h1]You need [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1603631350]"Mod config Menu"[/url] to customize this mod![/h1]
[b]This mod does [u]not[/u] disable achievements![/b]
[h1]Special Thanks[/h1] to Piber for the Mod config menu! to Skojanza for helping me bugfix this mod[/spoiler]
